Der Server meldet sich, wenn etwas nicht: The server speaks up when something is wrong, and once more when it is over – each message at most once an hour per channel. The messages name no accounts, only numbers. When a channel fails, the server tries again later and shows it on the overview.

Dieser Server verlangt ab {date} die Zwe: This server requires two-step login from {date}. After that, apps, extensions and the CLI only log you in once it is set up.
Dieser Server verlangt ein stärkeres Mas: This server asks for a stronger master password (level {need} of 4, this one has {has}).

Dieser Server verlangt seit {date} einen: Since {date} this server requires a second step at login. Until you have set one up, the web vault shows only this, and apps, browser extensions and the CLI do not log you in.
